d: In this episode of Lallantop Bihar Adda 2026, Abhishek Manchanda talks to young rappers Abhay KD and Nikhil about their journey in hip-hop, the struggles of everyday life and finding their voice through music. The duo also breaks down the language of rap, explaining popular hip-hop terms, rap vocabulary and the culture behind the music. From personal experiences to the realities of being young rappers, this conversation offers a glimpse into the world of independent hip-hop.
